about_short_description.short_description: Soomgo is an online marketplace that is designed to connect customers to various service providers.

product.name: Local Service Marketplace
product.description: Soomgo operates as a marketplace connecting customers with service providers for over 1,000 services, including home cleaning, moving, repairs, and personal training.

product.name: Home Cleaning
product.description: Offers cleaning services for homes, including regular, moving-in, and special cleaning.

product.name: Moving Services
product.description: Provides moving services for households, including packing, transportation, and unpacking.

product.name: Repair and Installation
product.description: Connects customers with professionals for appliance repair and installation services.

product.name: Personal Training
product.description: Offers personal training services, including fitness coaching and diet planning.

product.name: Employment Support Services
product.description: Provides job preparation consulting, including resume writing and interview coaching.
